items.title: Jules Cahn Interview, 1974-10-06
items.q: His name was Finn. He joined the Black Eagles tribe. He wrote a paper on it and very interesting. And he, too, is a very interesting fellow.

ctx.x: Could you or I become, if you were, could you or I?

There is, there has been one Caucasian, a fellow from. Do they, is the color line very drawn? Yeah, but there has been one Caucasian, a fellow that was an anthropology student at Tulane. And I think he was either Swedish or Danish. His name was Finn. He joined the Black Eagles tribe. He wrote a paper on it and very interesting. And he, too, is a very interesting fellow.
I think that's what I, I mean, what research I did do. I think maybe that was what I was reading. Must have been his notes that he had made.
